Filed Date - 2026-09-18 10:57:30 PM

Control Number - 59475

Item Number - 6585
 "I support Kevin Kennedy and John
M. Burrow's request in Item 6571 for
an independent technical
investigation and forensic audit of the
modeling underlying the 2024
Permian Basin Reliability Plan.




Before further irreversible
commitments are made, I ask the
Commission to obtain an
independent evaluation of the
modeling assumptions, reconcile
material differences between the
PBRP and the 2024 Regional
Transmission Plan, and publicly
explain whether each proposed 765-
kV import path remains justified.
 I also support the requested pause
while that work is completed and
reviewed. My support for an audit
does not presume misconduct or a
predetermined result. It reflects the
importance of getting decisions of
this scale right."
